summary: Seabridge Gold filed its Form 6-K covering the second-quarter 2026 report to shareholders, financial statements, and MD&A. The filing reports Q2 net income of $117.5 million, largely from gains on the distribution of the Courageous Lake project (a previously completed spin-out), and mentions a US$100 million short-term loan facility with a strategic investor, drawable at the company's election with 7% interest maturing December 31, 2026. No current special-situation event is announced; the filing is routine periodic reporting.
